events.dataContent:
Deportivo Alavés vs Real Sociedad: Live Stream & Watch Online

As the Copa del Rey heats up, fans brace for a compelling encounter between Deportivo Alavés and Real Sociedad. This fixture promises an intriguing battle, with Alavés looking to leverage home advantage to upset their higher-ranked opponents, while Real Sociedad aims to assert their dominance and progress further in Spain's prestigious knockout competition. The stakes are undeniably high, with both teams eager to continue their cup journey and build momentum in their respective seasons. Kick-off: 04.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: Estadio de Mendizorroza
Competition: Spain - Copa del Rey

Match Preview

Deportivo Alavés enters this Copa del Rey clash with a mixed bag of results in their recent league form. While often showing resilience, their home performances have been crucial for picking up points. Manager Luis García Plaza will be keen to instill a fighting spirit in his squad, knowing that cup competitions often bring out the best in underdogs. Real Sociedad, on the other hand, comes into this tie with a strong run of form, consistently challenging for European spots in La Liga. Under Imanol Alguacil, they've developed into a well-drilled unit known for their tactical discipline and attacking prowess. This cup tie presents a classic David vs. Goliath narrative, albeit with Alavés hoping to prove that giant-killing is well within their capabilities, especially on their home turf. The history between these two Basque clubs often produces fiery encounters. While Real Sociedad typically holds the upper hand on paper, the Copa del Rey has a notorious way of leveling the playing field. Alavés will need to be defensively resolute and clinical on the counter, aiming to exploit any complacency from their visitors. Real Sociedad will likely focus on controlling possession and dictating the tempo, relying on their creative midfielders and potent attackers to break down Alavés' defense. Expect a tactical chess match, with both managers looking for the strategic edge to gain a precious Copa del Rey victory.

Team Form and Analysis

Deportivo Alavés

Alavés' strength often lies in their defensive organization and ability to hit teams on the break. At home, they transform into a more formidable outfit, buoyed by their passionate support. Key players like Samu Omorodion, if fit, will be crucial in leading their attack and providing a physical presence. Defensively, the experienced Rafa Marín will need to be at his best to thwart Sociedad's advances. Injury concerns are minimal heading into this fixture, allowing Luis García Plaza to field a strong side, aiming to capitalize on any fatigue or rotation from their opponents. Their midfield battle will be crucial in disrupting Sociedad's rhythm and launching quick transitions.

Real Sociedad

Real Sociedad's current form is impressive, and they possess a squad brimming with talent across all departments. Their midfield, marshaled by Mikel Merino and Brais Méndez, is particularly strong, capable of both winning possession and orchestrating intricate attacking moves. Upfront, the likes of Takefusa Kubo and Mikel Oyarzabal provide pace, creativity, and goal-scoring threat. While Real Sociedad may rotate some players due to their demanding schedule, their depth ensures that any lineup they field will be highly competitive. They will likely dominate possession and seek to create numerical advantages in wide areas, exploiting Alavés' flanks. Key player returns from minor knocks could see their strongest eleven take to the field, signaling their intent to go deep in the cup.

The Coppa Italia heats up as defending champions Internazionale prepare to host a resilient Torino side in what promises to be a thrilling encounter. With both teams eyeing progression in the prestigious domestic cup, this knockout fixture carries immense weight. Internazionale will be looking to continue their dominant domestic form, while Torino, under the shrewd guidance of Ivan Jurić, will aim to spring a surprise and etch their name into the next round. This clash offers a compelling narrative of tactical discipline against attacking prowess, set to unfold in front of a passionate Milan crowd. Kick-off: 04.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: Stadio Giuseppe Meazza, Milan
Competition: Italy - Coppa Italia

Match Preview

Internazionale enter this Coppa Italia fixture on the back of a strong run in Serie A, establishing themselves as formidable title contenders. Their recent performances have been characterized by a clinical attack and a surprisingly robust defense, a testament to Simone Inzaghi's tactical adjustments. The Nerazzurri will be eager to maintain their momentum and assert their dominance in the cup competition, which they have lifted multiple times in recent history. However, Inzaghi might opt for some squad rotation to manage player fatigue, given their demanding league schedule. Key players will likely still feature, ensuring a high level of performance. Torino, on the other hand, arrive in Milan as the underdogs, but with a reputation for being a tough nut to crack. Ivan Jurić's side is well-drilled, defensively organized, and capable of punishing any complacency. Their recent league form has been inconsistent, but in cup competitions, their ability to perform under pressure often shines through. Torino will need to be at their absolute best, replicating the defensive solidity and swift counter-attacks that have troubled bigger teams this season. Injuries could play a role, with Jurić hoping to have his key defensive lynchpins available for this challenging away trip.

Team Form and Analysis

Internazionale

Internazionale's strength lies in their fluid attacking trio and the creative prowess of their midfield. Their defense, marshaled by experienced veterans, has shown significant improvement, turning tight games into comfortable victories. Inzaghi has instilled a winning mentality, allowing them to grind out results even when not at their scintillating best. While some fringe players might get an opportunity, the core of the team, including their prolific strikers and influential midfielders, is expected to lead the charge. Injury concerns are minimal, offering Inzaghi a full complement of options.

Torino

Torino's form has been a mixed bag in recent weeks, but their resilience is never in doubt. They tend to play with a high press and a compact, physical style that can disrupt even the most established opponents. Their success will heavily depend on their ability to contain Internazionale's creative outlets and exploit any potential space on the counter. Key to their strategy will be their midfield battle, where they will aim to win second balls and dictate the tempo. Updates on a couple of minor knocks within the squad are still pending, which could impact Jurić's final team selection.

The Carabao Cup Round of 16 presents a tantalizing clash as reigning champions Manchester City host Newcastle United at the Etihad Stadium. This high-stakes encounter sees two of the Premier League's most ambitious clubs vie for a place in the quarter-finals, promising a fierce battle under the floodlights. Both teams will be eager to assert their dominance and continue their journey in a competition that often provides a direct route to silverware. Kick-off: 04.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: Etihad Stadium
Competition: England - League Cup

Match Preview

Manchester City enter this fixture in formidable form, having firmly established themselves at the top of the Premier League. Pep Guardiola's side has demonstrated their customary attacking prowess and tactical flexibility, with key players hitting their stride early in the season. Their home record remains exceptional, making the Etihad a fortress for visiting teams. Expect City to field a strong side, albeit with potential rotations given the demanding fixture schedule, but their depth means any changed XI is still packed with international quality. Newcastle United, under Eddie Howe, have shown significant improvement and ambition. While perhaps not enjoying the same relentless winning streak as their hosts, they have proven themselves capable of upsetting top-tier opposition, especially in cup competitions. Their recent performances suggest a team growing in confidence, bolstered by a robust defensive structure and increasingly potent attack. The Magpies will see this as an opportunity to make a statement and progress in a competition where they reached the final just last season.

Manchester City's defense has been typically solid, conceding few goals in recent league outings, a testament to their organized pressing and dominant possession. Offensively, they remain a juggernaut, with Erling Haaland leading the line supported by an array of creative midfielders and wingers. Kevin De Bruyne's potential return or continued integration into the squad from injury will be a significant boost, adding even more creative impetus. Guardiola might opt to rest a couple of his regulars, but the core of the team is expected to be maintained to ensure progression. Recent form suggests City are in peak condition, seamlessly integrating new tactics and players.

Up front, Alexander Isak and Miguel Almíron offer pace and goal threat. Newcastle has shown a tendency to play direct when necessary but can also build attacks patiently. Their away form has been a slight concern in the league, but cup ties often bring a different level of intensity. The team will need to be at their absolute best, disciplined and clinical, to overcome the reigning champions. Injury concerns for a few fringe players might limit Howe's rotation options, making the fitness of his key starters paramount.
